column1: # Guest preparation for the pqc-readiness scanner (run-matrix.sh --prepare).
# key<TAB>command: key is a distros.tsv alias, a family, or *. Commands run
# as root after SSH is up, before the scanner; a failure fails the distro.
# pqc-readiness needs Python 3.9+. EL8 and Leap 15 ship 3.6 (or no python3),
# so install a newer one, as pqc-readiness's README tells users, and point
# EL 8.8+ has python3.11 in AppStream. rhel8 needs a registered system (or
# a local repo) for dnf to reach it.
